name: az-studio
description: AZ Studio — private AI filmmaking portal (Gemini Omni, Nano Banana Pro, Gemini Pro on Vertex AI).

scripts.test:integration: node scripts/render-rules.mjs --test && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-az-studio --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,tasks "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts"
